latestVersion.changelog:
Self-Help Author Skill v1.0.0

- Launch of a comprehensive self-help writing skill modeled after bestselling authors.
- Converts any topic or prompt into NYT-quality motivational chapters, book outlines, or manuscripts.
- Enforces a four-pillar bestseller formula: TRUTH, STORY, INSIGHT, ACTION.
- Delivers structured templates for chapters, book architecture, and reference story integration.
- Sets strict standards for tone, fact-checking, storytelling, and positive, actionable content.
- Includes detailed instructions for citing sources, building reader connection, and avoiding clichés.
